data.title: Ecommerce Trends: Which online retailers AI is helping the most
data.description: Updated Q2 AI Commerce Rankings from Digital Commerce 360 and ReFiBuy show how online retailers' visibility in AI shopping channels continues to evolve, with Nixon taking the top spot and automotive retailers posting some of the strongest gains.

data.title: Adobe: AI-referral traffic spending, converting more than counterparts
data.description: In July 2026, AI-referral traffic to U.S. retail sites increased 62% year over year, according to Adobe. And compared to October 2024, when generative AI platforms such as OpenAI's ChatGPT become more widespread, AI-referral traffic has increased 1,219%.

data.title: Glass launches AI-powered upgrades for its government procurement marketplace
data.description: The government purchasing technology company is rolling out AI-driven search, analytics and quote-request tools as it seeks to expand the cohorts of sellers, agencies and schools that use its procurement marketplace.

data.title: Medline tallies tariff refunds as Q2 sales rise 11.6%
data.description: Medical supplies distributor Medline recorded $243 million in tariff refunds during its fiscal year through Q2, helping drive revenue growth even as a California warehouse fire weighed on quarterly profits.

data.title: Freightos grows Q2 revenue despite global shipping disruptions
data.description: War in the Middle East, which has disrupted major shipping and air traffic hubs, continued to pressure Freightos’ booking volume in Q2. However, recovery was "stronger than what we had previously anticipated," according to its CEO.
